risks.note: Named as a key identified risk in the ERM framework. The BRSR material-issues table explains the Company focuses mostly on Fortune 1000 organizations and embeds itself in customer training and upskilling, which results in fewer customers having a large share of revenue; the newly acquired iamneo works with top universities where a few hold a significant portion of revenue share. Management argues the risk of failure of these customers is low and there is a steep entry barrier.

MD&A states that while diversified service offerings reduce overall exposure, certain concentration risks remain in the Technology and BFSI sectors. In FY26 this was evidenced by a sharp slowdown in BFSI new-hire training due to a risk-off stance among large private sector banks, and by reduced onboarding activity at GSIs amid macro uncertainty.
risks.risk: Sector concentration in Technology and BFSI

risks.note: The only BRSR material issue classified purely as a Risk with negative financial implications. Threats listed include ransomware attacks, data breach, third-party security vulnerabilities, increased digital dependency and AI-enabled attacks, which can result in theft of sensitive customer data and reputational damage. Mitigations include DLP systems, NGFW firewalls, email security, third-party VAPT and periodic internal vulnerability scans, RBAC, strong password policy, MFA on critical and custom applications, XDR/threat hunting with real-time response, phishing simulations and an in-progress online TPRM.

BRSR flags AI as both risk and opportunity: customers may opt to use Gen AI for content creation, and commoditization of AI-generated training content risks erosion of competitive differentiation. In learning delivery, learners' use of AI to complete assessments without genuine skill development, and the inability to validate actual learner competency in AI-assisted environments, can produce unreliable certification outcomes.
risks.risk: Artificial Intelligence commoditising learning content and undermining assessment integrity

risks.note: Named among the key identified risks in the ERM framework, and the BRSR treats talent attraction and development as a material issue for a talent development corporation. BRSR Section A reports permanent-employee turnover of 31% in FY26 (35% male, 25% female) against 30% in FY25 and 42% in FY24.

Listed among the key risks identified under the Enterprise Risk Management framework, alongside customer concentration, people and talent, cyber security and data protection, investments and foreign exchange exposure.

Both are named key identified risks under the ERM framework. NIIT serves customers in India and other growth economies as a multinational enterprise, and BRSR Section A discloses exports at 6.22% of total turnover with markets served across 29 countries.

BRSR material issue: failure to comply with policies such as the code of conduct and anti-bribery and corruption often leads to significant reputational damage. Mitigated through a company-wide Global Compliance Management System (GCMS) assigning each applicable legal provision to an individual with second-level confirmation, plus whistleblower and related-party policies reviewed independently by internal audit.

sk.overview: The company is positioned in the modular exhibition stands industry serving the Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Exhibitions (MICE) sector in India. Modular exhibition stands are flexible and reusable display structures used by businesses to showcase their brands, products and services at trade fairs, exhibitions, conferences, expos and promotional events. Unlike traditional custom-built stands that are typically designed for one-time use, modular stands are made from prefabricated components that can be assembled, dismantled and reconfigured multiple times based on event requirements.
